nodes.content:
import geopandas as gpd
import pandas as pd
from shapely.geometry import Point

dataset_path = curio_data_path("data.cityofchicago.green-roofs")
df = pd.read_csv(dataset_path).dropna(subset=["LONGITUDE", "LATITUDE"])
points = [Point(xy) for xy in zip(df["LONGITUDE"], df["LATITUDE"])]

return gpd.GeoDataFrame(df, geometry=points, crs=4326)
nodes.goal: Load Chicago's green roofs as points.

import geopandas as gpd

dataset_path = curio_data_path("data.projectsidewalk.chicago-labels")
gdf = gpd.read_parquet(dataset_path)

# Every 365th label: 400 points spread across the city.
return gdf[["label_type", "severity", "geometry"]].iloc[::365]

    geometry=[box(-87.65, 41.92, -87.64, 41.93), box(-87.64, 41.92, -87.63, 41.93)],
    crs=4326,
)
